summary: Canada Lookouts dates a Bulldog Mountain lookout building to 1950 and marks it removed; a fire on the mountain was reported in 2018. No source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Canada Lookouts marks the lookout as removed; no source found describes what remains on the mountain.

events.note: Canada Lookouts dates construction of a lookout building on Bulldog Mountain to this year
Valley Voice (6 September 2018) reports a Bulldog Mountain fire with a structural protection specialist assigned; the excerpt read does not name the lookout

evidence.supports: Site marks the lookout as removed
Listed in the Central Kootenay district
A structural protection specialist was assigned to the Bulldog Mountain fire
The role assigned was Structural Protection Specialist

notes_for_editor: Only one tower page (Canada Lookouts) gives a construction year and a status, and it gives no unit for elevation (1495) or a date for removal. Coordinates conflict: the record uses the BC TRIM fire-lookout feature (49.3906, -118.08667) and Canada Lookouts gives 49.383, -118.083, about 886 m apart; the record notes this and it is unresolved. A 2017 hiking blog by Ron Perrier describes an abandoned lookout on the summit reached by road; the blog returns HTTP 403 to the reader, so it is not cited. A search summary of it gives 4583 feet (about 1397 m), which does not match 1495. The Valley Voice PDF text is laid out in columns; the fire line is quoted from a single line and does not show whether the lookout was affected. No builder, design, staffing or access source was found.
